The application is built and verified. Here's where we've landed.

## Your Link Library is ready to try
**http://maker:4000** — the real, working application (not the exploratory prototype). It starts empty, exactly as a new library would.

## Verification — all passed
I checked the finished software against every behavior we agreed on:

- **41 automated checks** covering each of the 12 flows end-to-end (saving & enrichment, tags, notes, search query language, reading list, archive, preserved copies incl. PDFs, editing, duplicate-prevention, delete, sorting, bulk actions, error handling, and persistence).
- **A browser end-to-end test** driving the actual UI: empty state → save → duplicate blocked → bad input rejected → search → reading list → archive/restore → delete.
- Result: **41/41 passing, browser test passing.**

## What it does (all confirmed working)
Everything from our sessions: save a page from one box with an auto-fetched title/description and a preserved copy; open the original; tag (reuse or create, shown on cards); Markdown notes with preview/expand; live search with `#tag`, "phrases", AND/OR/NOT and parentheses; reading list and archive as separate views; preserved copies (readable content for pages, original file for PDFs); full edit; duplicate-prevention; confirmed permanent delete; sorting and safely-scoped bulk actions; friendly empty/error states; nothing auto-expires.

## One honest note
Fetching titles and preserving copies makes real network requests. In this review environment outbound access may be limited — if a page can't be reached, you'll see exactly the approved behavior: the link is **still saved** with a "Copy unavailable" warning and a **Retry** button, so nothing is lost. That's the SCN-011 flow working as designed, not a defect.

I've also recorded the internal design notes and a scenario-to-code-to-test map so future changes can be scoped.

**Do you accept this software as complete for this cycle**, on the basis of the behavior we approved and this verification? If anything doesn't match what we agreed, tell me and I'll treat it as a correction within this cycle; genuinely new ideas I'll log for a future cycle.
